headline: The Wall Street Journal reports that top U.S. chief executives are building crisis plans that cut across industries because of AI-related cyber risk.
score_reason: Lowered from 6 to 5: headline only, the article could not be opened.
importance_line: Large companies appear to be preparing joint responses to AI-enabled cyberattacks, which could matter to customers of banks and other critical services, but the participants and the plans are not confirmed.
summary: The Wall Street Journal reports that top U.S. CEOs are building cross-industry crisis plans in response to AI-related cyber risk.
notes: WSJ blocked (HTTP 401); no other outlet carrying the same story was found. A Yahoo Finance item the same day quotes JPMorgan's Jamie Dimon on a 50-company 'Alliance for Critical Infrastructure', but it was not confirmed to be the same plan, so it is not used.
